prompt: Roll a design system from seed 77. Derive the accent color, measure, line-height, density, and signature from the bounded answer space. Do not run the full strict gate — apply the relaxed gate only.
assertions: Emits the seed, the rolled answer table, and derived tokens.
Picks only from the bounded answer space in assets/bounded-space.json.
Applies the relaxed gate (contrast, readability, self-containment) not the full 19-skill strict gate.
Hands off to the same downstream skills as design-system-interview.

run_protocol.material_difference_requirement: Each seed must produce a materially different design system — different reference territory, different signature move, different accent hue.
run_protocol.negative_routing_requirement: The negative neighbor (design-system-interview) must be available as the manual alternative when the user rejects the rolled direction.
